Header file:
#include "ara/crypto/keys/key_storage_provider.h"
Description:
Commit changes of the transaction to Key Storage.
The commit command permanently saves all changes made during the transaction in Key
Storage and makes them visible to all "User" Actors/applications (according to their access
rights).
Notes:
Any changes of key slots made during a transaction are invisible to all "Users" (including the
"Owner" application) up to the commit execution!
[Error]: SecurityErrorDomain::kInvalidArgument if provided id is invalid, i.e. this ID is unknown
or correspondent transaction already was finished (commited or rolled back)
